metadata.title: Product Streams
metadata.description: Outcome-based streams of the shipping lifecycle: promise at checkout -> book and label -> ship freight -> route across locations -> inform and resolve -> return -> control cost, plus onboarding of systems, carriers and clients.
metadata.flowModelNote: Each step names the bricks it depends on; personas are documented in customers.json JTBD steps.

streams.name: Offer Reliable Delivery Options at Checkout
streams.description: From basket to a delivery promise the shopper chooses and the operation can keep: stock-aware options, pickup points, prices and CO2 shown live in the checkout, booked automatically after payment.
outcomes: Lower cost through steering shoppers to efficient options

flows.title: Basket to promise
flows.description: A shopper enters an address and sees only feasible options.

steps.title: Check stock and earliest complete delivery
keyFacts: Stock per location and replenishment dates are checked
Orders are classed as available now, complete later or unknown
painPoints: Stock feeds lag behind the store or warehouse

streams.name: Automate Shipment Booking and Labels
streams.description: From an order in a webshop, marketplace, ERP or WMS to a pre-announced shipment with label, documents and track-and-trace - automatically, by one scan, or with one click - across 200+ carriers.

Addresses are checked before booking
painPoints: Orders arrive incomplete (no weight or dimensions)

streams.name: Orchestrate Multi-Warehouse and External Fulfilment
streams.description: Ship each order from the best location - own warehouse, store, 3PL, supplier or dropshipper - with the external party booking through the same platform and status flowing back.
outcomes: Fewer split shipments and empty kilometres
External stock sold without manual forwarding
One view of all shipments regardless of ship-from
